prompt: Who is the most recent recipient of a Nobel Prize in one of the sciences who held Asian citizenship at the time of the award?
answer: The most recent was **Susumu Kitagawa of Japan**, who received the **2025 Nobel Prize in Chemistry**—shared with Richard Robson and Omar M. Yaghi—for the development of **metal–organic frameworks**. He held Japanese citizenship at the time of the award.
